competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 30% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy quickly and strongly. Ignores the enemy's Defense if the target's Defense is 60% or less than your Attack Power.

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease Defense for 3 turns. Afterwards, increases your Attack Bar by 50% and additionally increases your Attack Bar by up to 50% in proportion to the enemy's HP lost by this attack.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
